intro.title: Tell me what you're
intro.kicker: Could be a whole network rebuild, could be one plugin that refuses to behave. Send over the details either way and I'll tell you if I'm the right person for it.

channels.label: Discord, fastest reply
channels.note: Easily the best way to reach me. I read everything and usually answer the same day, UTC+1.

channels.label: Email
channels.note: Better for longer briefs, quotes, or anything with files attached.

channels.label: BuiltByBit
channels.note: If you'd rather go through platform escrow, that works for me.

aside.title: Before you write
points: Tell me what you're running now and what keeps breaking.
A rough budget and deadline saves us both a round of messages.
Screenshots or config files are always welcome.

form.title: Start the conversation.
form.note: This lands in my Discord as soon as you send it. No account, no newsletter, nothing else happens to your details.

placeholders.name: What should I call you?
placeholders.message: What are you running, what's broken, and where do you want it in six months?

form.successBody: It's in my Discord now. I'll get back to you within about twelve hours.
form.errorGeneric: That didn't send. Give it another go in a moment, or just message me on Discord.
form.errorDisabled: The form isn't hooked up yet, so please use Discord or email above.

faq.title: The usual questions.
faq.kicker: If yours isn't here, just ask.

items.question: How do you price work?
items.answer: Fixed price per project, quoted once we've talked through what's involved. Small jobs like a permissions fix or a single plugin config are a flat fee. Bigger network or Discord rebuilds get quoted in stages, so you can stop after any milestone if you want to.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A single plugin or permissions job is usually a few days. A full server configuration runs two to four weeks. Network rebuilds and staff programmes take longer, mostly because they involve training people rather than just editing files.

items.question: What do I get at the end?
items.answer: The working setup, documentation covering why things are the way they are, a call to walk you and your staff through it, and two weeks of support for anything that turns up once real players get their hands on it.

items.question: Can you work on a server that already exists?
items.answer: Yes, that's most of what I do. I'll audit what you've got first and tell you honestly what's worth keeping. I'm not going to push a rebuild on you if a smaller fix does the job.
